observations: The candidate boat replaces a simple block model with a detailed fishing vessel while retaining a readable top-down silhouette.
All five candidate corals show materially finer natural surface structure and less geometric repetition than the baseline set.
The candidate fish adds a complete high-contrast PBR skin and remains readable at small scale.
The candidate rock preserves its baked photogrammetry detail at 856 triangles.
The candidate seabed retains modeled ripple geometry and embedded PBR textures after being normalized to a square harbor footprint.
The candidate starfish is rounded and textured while retaining the interaction silhouette.
warnings: The sea-fan source is naturally dark; underwater absorption and lighting must be judged in browser WebGL before final color approval.
Headless captures remap texture channels above UV1 to UV0 because the CPU renderer supports two UV streams. Production GLBs are unchanged.
